summary: secondary.ts lastTarget* conditions (lastTargetColor/Race/Status/Survived) look the last target up with findCharacter(ctx.state, id); once the hit kills it the unit is gone and the condition is false. Native Shadow Wraith 9550: CountArmyColor@RandomEnemy Purple (step 0, before the hit) -> Damage@FromPrevious -> GenerateHalfManaConditional, so a Purple target killed by the hit must still refund half the mana. Related: P-R1-count-at-native-step (counts at the native Count step), P-F2-dead-target-colour (gems LAST_TARGET colour after a kill). Needs the last target's colours/types captured when it is picked (castTracking), or a count-at-step source.
repro: castSpell({key:'troop:7646', seed:7, enemies:[{hp:1,maxHp:1,colors:['Purple']},{hp:100,maxHp:100,colors:['Red']}]}) -> dmg E10 13, defeat E10, no mana; native: +6 (half of 12).
